SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as num_boats, 
  ROUND(AVG(yt::float / NULLIF(anglers, 0)), 2) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 199 AND 213
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, avg_yt_per_angler DESC;
